summary: legal checked in 5 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; conditional for continued private preview and preparation of an unsent permission request. Evidence: Woot API access is documented, but current public terms do not establish commercial/public redistribution, historical derivatives, caching, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, or takedown rights. Compliance is incomplete fleet-wide (37 pass, 16 fail, 6 unknown); SearchWoot security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, attribution, privacy, and owner gates remain open. Exact decision: keep the private gate unchanged, authorize only preparation of an unsent Woot permission request after owner approval, and do not send outreach, launch publicly, expand monetization, or change production. Human counsel is required for final source-rights interpretation, any written permission, and jurisdiction-specific privacy review. Missing telemetry is unavailable evidence, not a growth blocker for unrelated bounded workstreams.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active. No legal task is closed because the evidence is incomplete: source-rights evidence is blocked; data-flow evidence is partial; consent/analytics evidence is partial; vendor, log, incident, and request-handling evidence is not complete. Next evidence actions are concrete: produce the repository/deployed-configuration data-flow and retention table; capture deployed consent behavior and GA4 settings read-only; inventory log fields, vendors, retention/access controls, and incident/request procedures; and obtain authoritative Woot permission or terms.

Data-use dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data — blocked; missing current written rights, field-level provenance, permitted retention/display/alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, and image/price/availability permissions. Smallest next action: prepare an unsent permission request for owner approval. User alert rules and sync results — evidence_needed; missing data inventory, retention/deletion/correction/access workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce a read-only data-flow and retention table from the repository and deployed configuration. GA4 analytics — evidence_needed; missing deployed consent and withdrawal evidence, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdiction-specific review. Smallest next action: capture consent/configuration evidence without enabling tracking or advertising. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data — evidence_needed; missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA review, and incident/data-subject-request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only operator/vendor inventory. Human counsel is required before public launch for source rights and jurisdiction-specific privacy conclusions.

Continue the six already-approved bounded workstreams with their existing technical gates and measurement thresholds. Legal does not block ordinary growth solely because analytics is incomplete. Do not make site-level revenue, ROI, margin, CAC, payback, profitability, or forecast claims: Amazon revenue is $4.92 at portfolio level, one tracking ID is unmapped, attribution is incomplete, and direct costs are unavailable. Affiliate disclosures, stale-link repairs, claims, provenance, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive issues must be checked within each site's existing work before publication or monetization expansion.
Private/gated-site decision: keep SearchWoot private. No go-live proposal is supported by the evidence, so no implementation.launch_gate or legal_review approval is issued.
